composition_label: Product comparison (Smart product search) -> Interest-based recommendations (Personalized discovery)

construction.implementation_origin: New self-contained implementation written for this isolated build

shared_schema.input: Synthetic marker, EU/US residency, consenting subscriber account with preferences, offers, call-detail CSV, network fault tickets, support chat transcripts, billing adjustments.
shared_schema.stages: Both stage envelopes carry schema_version, synthetic_fixture, residency_tag, aggregate context, preferences and ranked rows. Shared rows contain offer_id, residency_tag, monthly_price_cents, data_mb, network_quality, tags, preference_score and rank.
shared_schema.validation: validate() is the common input and interstage/output contract boundary. It enforces numeric bounds, references, uniqueness, consent/purpose, residency, adjustment reasons, score recomputation, ordering and grounded explanations.
shared_schema.output: One JSON object: status, schema_version, synthetic_fixture, comparison, recommendations. Errors emit status=error and a non-sensitive message with exit code 2.

cross_stage_handoffs: compare validates and normalizes all input records, aggregates usage/fault context, scores offers and validates its comparison table.
recommend consumes only the validated comparison envelope, preserving normalized attributes, base scores, preferences and aggregate context; it never rereads raw subscriber records.
Final recommendations are validated for exclusions, order, scores, explanations and residency.

behavior.normalization: Decimal GB uses 1000 MB. USD prices must have whole cents. Network quality is an integer 0-100.
behavior.comparison: Data fit uses max(requested minimum, aggregate observed data); capped data fit gets 40 percent weight, capped affordability 40 percent and network quality 20 percent. An open fault moves 20 percent from affordability to network quality. Scores round half up to integer 0-10000. Side-by-side columns and ranked offer rows are emitted.
behavior.recommendations: Each exact matched interest adds 400 points to the comparison score. Excluded offer IDs are removed before top_n selection. Ties use ascending offer_id. Budget is a soft ranking preference, not a hard filter; unknown exclusions safely have no effect.
behavior.privacy: Demonstrative GDPR/CCPA-oriented purpose/consent gates, synthetic-only identifier checks, aggregate-only usage output and omission of phone/IMEI/account ID/chat text/billing reasons. No legal compliance certification or comprehensive PII detector.
behavior.residency: Every input domain record and stage record must match the envelope's residency tag; no physical hosting/residency assurance is claimed.
behavior.billing: All adjustments, including zero-value adjustments, require a nonblank stated reason; adjustments are validated but not executed.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly labeled invented account, tickets and chats; reserved fictional phone range and explicitly invalid-for-real-use SYNTH-IMEI markers. Example volumes are synthetic. Tests generate randomized volumes with fixed seed 4040.
behavior.edge_cases: Empty CDR body and empty related-record lists allowed; empty offer set rejected; all-excluded recommendations return an empty list; free plans and no interests supported.

test_outcomes.cli_example: passed: one JSON object, status ok, two recommendations
test_outcomes.deliverable_check: Exactly the four requested files; no generated bytecode or auxiliary files
